# Copilot instructions for ChemEx

Read and follow the repository-root [`AGENTS.md`](../AGENTS.md) before proposing
or making changes. It is the canonical operational guide for repository
orientation, scientific safeguards, extension paths, compatibility, and
validation.

Use [`CONTRIBUTING.md`](../CONTRIBUTING.md) for the current development setup and
commands. Treat the current source, tests, schemas, examples, `pyproject.toml`,
and CI workflows as authoritative when this pointer or another document becomes
stale.
